title: noccaea capricornuta
intro: Noccaea capricornuta, commonly known as Mountain Wintercress, is a perennial plant belonging to the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It has been traditionally used to support lung and digestive health, offering potential benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Wintercress are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, that may modulate immune responses and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, the plant's bioactive compounds may also exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer activities, making it a subject of ongoing research in the field of pharmacology and traditional medicine.
